patterns.note: A split-screen interactive scroll layout where a left-aligned vertical menu remains sticky while content cards scroll on the right.
As the user scrolls, the left-hand vertical navigation highlights the active section in sync with the right-hand cards entering the viewport.
A deep monochromatic dark mode base punctuated by vibrant, content-specific card backgrounds (e.g., deep blue, dark teal, pure white) that define distinct context shifts.
High-contrast sans-serif typography with tight letter-spacing and prominent bold headings paired with small, muted metadata labels.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky split-scroll feature, use CSS position sticky on the left-hand navigation menu while allowing the right-hand cards to scroll naturally. Use an Intersection Observer or GSAP ScrollTrigger to detect which card is currently in view and dynamically update the active state (opacity and text color) of the corresponding menu item on the left.
Create a subtle radial spotlight effect behind the hero carousel using a CSS radial-gradient with a soft, low-opacity white/yellow center fading into the pure black background.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold headings (~4x body) with small, low-contrast uppercase labels and clean, highly readable body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle corner-radius on cards and pill-shaped buttons, maintaining a clean, modern tech aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, balanced with tight, structured layouts inside the interactive cards.

standout: The site stands out through its highly polished split-scroll interactive section, where a sticky left-hand menu seamlessly tracks and highlights the user's progress through beautifully rendered, content-rich product cards on the right.
